args.body: Take GHOST-PAID-SERVICE-REQUEST. The SQLite discovery sequence is complete, but neither reach nor demand is established. Test explicit buyer willingness to commission the existing migration capability before further inventory. Stop after three candidates; inaccessible sources or absent qualifying requests justify a bounded stop, not a global conclusion. A community account limits posting only; payment administration limits paid acceptance only. Preserve the unvalidated Ghost converter limits, unknown feedback attribution, and all existing deadlines.

description: SQLite publication and one IndexNow submission are verified; indexing and customer reach are not. Feedback remains available but uncertain: 0 classified and 3 unclassified sources, with no verified revenue or spendable funds. Next, test explicit paid Ghost migration demand rather than add another free diagnostic. Existing observation windows and retirement duties remain unchanged.
